description: C++ lab environment: clang-format (Google), clang-tidy, function complexity, GoogleTest, Makefile, git hooks and time tracking
config.llvmBinDir: Folder with clang-tidy, clang-format and clangd. Empty means detect automatically (Homebrew LLVM, /usr/lib/llvm-*, PATH).
config.minLlvmVersion: Minimum LLVM version; doctor warns if the found one is older.
config.clangTidy.profile.0: bugprone, google, modernize, performance, readability, misc + Google naming
config.clangTidy.profile.1: basic + cppcoreguidelines, cert, portability; warnings become errors
config.clangTidy.customConfig: Path to the instructor's .clang-tidy (for the custom profile).
config.complexity.enabled: Measure function complexity in C/C++ files.
config.complexity.maxLines: Function length limit in lines of code (Google: ~40).
config.time.enabled: Track time spent on the lab.
config.time.idleMinutes: Stop counting time after this many minutes without activity.
config.tests.buildArgs: Extra make arguments when building tests, e.g. ["SAN="].
config.task.files: Task files in the lab root, in priority order (file name case is ignored).
config.gitHooks.preCommit: pre-commit checks for staged files: format runs clang-format, tidy runs clang-tidy (warnings count as errors).
config.gitHooks.prePush: pre-push checks: test runs make test.
untrusted: Lab Kit runs make, compilers and git hooks from the workspace.
config.language: Language of Lab Kit messages, panels, reports and generated Makefiles and hooks. Command and setting names follow the VS Code language.
config.clangTidy.profile.auto: The CI config from .github/workflows (tidy-config) if there is one, otherwise basic
config.clangTidy.profile.ci: Exactly the tidy-config from .github/workflows, the one CI grades codestyle with
config.cmake.buildDir: CMake build directory relative to the lab root.
config.cmake.configureArgs: Extra arguments for cmake -S . -B build, e.g. ["-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug"].
